cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You showed me the rescue dog's photo, not the page saying he eats sofas.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I understand. Admit that hiding the sofa page changed my yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Before we feed him another one, say I should have had both pages.

mechanism: A accepts the rescue motive but controls what acknowledgment must precede material compensation.
confusable: Unlike seeking a replacement sofa, A demands recognition that withheld information changed consent.
comparison: A pet decision and offered replacement differ from the cancelled-party apology.
seedUse: Use omitted sofa-destruction page and replacement offer; the original already conditions proceeding on the acknowledgment A requires.
